corrections.evidence: Rayo official profile gives the full name Sergio Camello Pérez and forward position. Atlético official debut report explicitly records his first-team LaLiga appearance and goal against Levante; Levante match report records Camello entering at 46 minutes and scoring at 79, dated 18 May 2019 in the indexed official report. This is inside 2010-11 to 2025-26. Fame 2 follows the existing LaLiga-striker scale for Hugo Duro and Abdón Prats.

Premier League 9 August 2018 announcement identifies the Belgium player and defensive capability. Wolves 13 February 2021 preview explicitly states he played in the back three against Leicester, and refers to the Premier League clean sheet. It also documents three months in that role in the previous winter. This establishes actual defender deployment and Premier League appearances before 2025-26, not merely a transfer or squad place. Fame 3 follows the question’s established middle scale for Castagne and Hoefkens. Existing fuzzy surname matching handles observed misspellings, so no typo aliases added.
